days.title: Old Town Landmarks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Munot Fortress
stops.detail: One particular highlight is the Munot Fortress.

stops.name: Haus zum Ritter
stops.detail: Marvel at historic buildings such as the Haus zum Ritter and make a stop at Herrenacker: the largest square in the old town is surrounded by restaurants and cafés, making it an ideal place to take a break.

stops.name: Museum zu Allerheiligen
stops.detail: From here, visit the Museum zu Allerheiligen.

stops.name: Fronwagplatz
stops.detail: Or continue to roam through the city’s alleyways and take a break at one of the fountains on Fronwagplatz.
